Name: Pet Spawn Location
Author: Shaklin
Description:
[center][b][size=4]Pet Spawn Location[/size]

If you have 2 or more Cats and Dogs, then maybe this mod is for you.
you can place your pets anywhere!
Simply set a new location for them via console (﻿even in the town, NPC houses or your teammates' house)!
(works with PC + Android)
[/b][/center]
Compatible with 1.5 and 1.6


Info for Stardew Valley 1.5:
[i]Not really needed with the mod "Adopt'n'Skin", because it also changes the spawn locations in the game.
So you not really need my mod, unless you want to place your pet in a specific place or if your pets get tangled.

Another good mods, if you want more pets:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2274]More Animals[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7407]Cats and Dogs
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin (Animal Skinner)[/url][/i]


[size=5][u]TOGGLE KEYS[/u]
[/size]Pets can walk through other pets: [b]PageDown [/b](on(off)
Farmer can walk through pets: [b]PageUp [/b](on/off)

(the toggle keys you can change in the config.json)


[size=5][u]CONSOLE[/u]
[/size][size=3][b]petspawnlocation
[/b]it shows all commands

[/size][size=3][b]petspawnlocation list
[/b]it shows all your pets as list

[size=3][b]petspawnlocation petname
[/b]sets the spawn location on non-rainy days for the pet

[size=3][size=3][b]petspawnlocation petname rain
[/b]sets the spawn [size=3][size=3]location [/size][/size]on rainy days for the pet

[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b]petspawnlocation petname reset
[/b]sets the spawn [size=3][size=3]locations [/size][/size]for the pet to default

[size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][size=3][b]petspawnlocation petname rename newpetname
[/b]renames the pet (you should save the game afterwards)


[/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size](the mod will remember your settings because it will be saved in a pets.json file.
If you have just adopted a pet, you have to enter your farmhouse once to update the pet.json list)
